blocks.x: **Status:** A made-up draft for the Matchbox demo. Nothing here is real.

Right now, our Saturday sing-along meets in a borrowed room that holds about 40 people, and most weeks every chair is taken. With this grant we would run twelve free evenings in a larger hall, with a guest musician each month and printed song sheets so newcomers can join in.

Each evening starts with a short story about where the songs come from. Then everyone sings together, with the words projected on the wall. [NEEDS INPUT: name of the hall we would rent]
People of every age come, from students to grandparents. About half of last season's visitors were there for the first time. [NEEDS INPUT: how many people came last season]

| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Hall rental, 12 evenings | $2,400.00 |
| Guest musicians | $1,800.00 |
| Song sheets and printing | $300.00 |
| **Total request** | **$4,500.00** |
